subject: mth
title: (R)MTH.------AF.DY.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 85 (WAM-27). MTH (methodology) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". The title names AF-DY (affinity dynamics); the chart has no label for it. From the subject: AFL-DY (affinity dynamics), MT-IMP (multi-implications), DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) and C-FO-ACT (composite focused activism). From MT-IMP: TR (transformation). From DYM-F: TRS (transition). From C-FO-ACT: CULT-INFO-DY (culture information dynamics). From TR: ROTP (responsibility of the position). From TRS: SOC-RT-P (social reality particular). From CULT-INFO-DY: POL-DYM (political dynamics). From SOC-RT-P: PART (participation). From POL-DYM: C-ACT (composite activism).
